Standalone Exponential Hybrid

Model N Exponential Hybrid, lambda=1

This experiment is isolated under Model_N_Shock_Breakout_PnL/Exponential_Hybrid. It computes w(q) = (exp(lambda * q) - 1) / (exp(lambda) - 1), then uses p_final = (1 - w(q)) * p_normal + w(q) * p_shock. PnL uses the same favorable BUY_YES/BUY_NO rule against Model K with selected-side edge threshold 0.0.
